AgentModeId.description:
Behavioral runtime profile for an agent turn.

This is distinct from [`TurnTicketMode`], which selects interactive versus background delivery. Agent modes preserve one Medousa identity while changing context, tools, lane policy, and completion behavior.

binary_present.description: Vendor CLI binary present on PATH.

AgentSecretFulfillRequest.description: Write-only credential material. Avoid `Debug` and `Clone`: callers should move the value directly into a zeroizing provision operation.
AgentSecretFulfillRequest.title: AgentSecretFulfillRequest

AgentSecretRequestBackend.description: Runtime boundary that receives an approved credential. OpenShell providers persist at the workshop gateway; Grapheme grants stay ephemeral and are exposed to one run only through opaque host capability handles.

AgentSecretRequestRecord.description: Public metadata for one agent-initiated credential request. Credential material is accepted only by the fulfill endpoint and is never copied into this record, turn events, tool output, or transcript storage.

AgentSecretRequestStatus.description: Lifecycle for an out-of-transcript secret request. The secret value is deliberately absent from every record and response type.

CalendarAlarm.description: Display alarm relative to event start (VALARM projection).

trigger_minutes_before.description: Minutes before `dtstart` when the alert should fire (e.g. 30, 1440).

note_path.description: Optional vault-relative markdown note linked to this event (`X-MEDOUSA-NOTE`).

recurrence_id.description: For expanded recurrence instances: original master UID (same as uid when not expanded).

alarms.description: Replace VALARM set on write (omit/empty clears).

CodeIntentContext.description: Bounded, user-intent-oriented context carried from the permanent Code workspace into an external coding-agent prompt. Paths are relative to the governed Forge worktree; the daemon remains authoritative for the cwd.

oneOf.description: Native Liquid scene pinned to a custom surface. `config.scene` holds an opaque scene payload (`{ ops: [...] }`) the daemon never interprets — the client decodes + renders it via the Liquid SceneRenderer.

ContextUsageLayer.description: One slice of the prompt/context budget (Cursor-style context usage UI).

ContextUsageReport.description: Turn-start context composition sent once per interactive turn.

context_limit_tokens.description: Model context window when known from capability registry / route.

ConversationRangeSelection.description: One committed contiguous range selected from a session. The lower bound is exclusive and the upper bound is inclusive; omitting `after_entry_seq` selects from the beginning of the session.

speaker_profile_id.description: Shared-room human speaker (`user:alice`). Absent on assistant turns / personal chats.

resume_provider_token.description: Optional ACP wire `sessionId` to resume (from a prior `RecoveryDisposition::ResumeSupported`). When omitted but `work_id` is set, the daemon looks up the latest resume token on that work item.

work_id.description: Optional Forge undertaking binding (`/v1/forge/items/{id}`). When set, the ACP session runs inside the governed worktree and reports leases.

config_options.description: Runtime-advertised ACP session controls. Clients must render these capability-first rather than assuming every agent supports model or reasoning selection.

resumed.description: True when the session was attached via ACP `session/resume` (or load).

agent_profile_id.description: Agent persona for shared rooms (defaults to `user:general` in Shared mode).

member_profile_ids.description: Required for `catalog: shared` — member seat profile ids.

session_id.description: Deprecated compatibility field. New sessions are always daemon-generated.

intent.description: Descriptive audit metadata such as `fork`, `work_context`, or `worker_context`; it does not select a different persistence path.

reused.description: True when this idempotency key had already committed the same request.

catalog.description: Phase 1 accepts `single` only. The field is explicit so shared/export policy can evolve without changing the derivation primitive.

manuscript_id.description: Primary YAML manuscript specialty for the ask turn.

suggested_capability_ids.description: Capability catalog ids the operator suggests for this ask.

ExecutionId.description: Durable execution identity. Legacy execution ids predate a generated prefix, so validation accepts bounded visible ASCII.

HostTurnContext.description: Bounded, advisory context captured by an editor, notes app, or browser. This never grants filesystem or vault authority to the sending client.

IngestAttachment.description: Optional attachment forwarded by a channel adapter.

IngestRequest.description: Request from any channel adapter to the centralized ingester.

attachments.description: Optional attachment payloads merged into ask prompts

text.description: The text content of the message (command or prompt)

user_id.description: User identifier within the channel, e.g. "telegram:user:12345"

IngestRequest.title: IngestRequest

is_new_session.description: Whether this is a brand-new session (first message or after /new)

job_id.description: If a job was enqueued, its id (for polling/streaming)

reply.description: Immediate text reply (help text, confirmation, error message)

session_id.description: The resolved or created session_id for this channel+user pair

stream_id.description: SSE stream id when a job-backed ask is processing

stream_ready.description: Whether the stream endpoint is ready for subscription

stream_url.description: Absolute URL for SSE stream consumption by adapters

agent_mode.description: Per-turn behavioral mode override. Omitted requests inherit task/session state.

code_context.description: Advisory editor/undertaking intent. Coder entry re-resolves Forge authority.

code_project_setup_authorized.description: The principal explicitly selected the surface action allowing unbound Coder to choose, bind, or create a project for this turn.

host_context.description: Advisory editor, note, or page snapshot. The daemon bounds and formats it.

identity_user_id.description: Optional identity principal override (debug/internal). Default: active workshop profile.

manuscript_id.description: YAML manuscript specialty for ranked digest + scheduled tool allowlist.

max_tool_rounds.description: When set, overrides `tui_defaults.json` for this turn (TUI live settings).

media_refs.description: User media uploaded to local medousa/media/ before this turn (P5a).

surface.description: Channel adapter context for ambient prompting (ingest/TUI surfaces).

voice_preset_id.description: Composer voice stance — short appendix block (not a manuscript specialty).

JsonRpcMessage.description: JSON-RPC or LSP message exchanged over a WebSocket upgrade

theme.description: Color theme for this layout — copied onto `EnvironmentSpec.theme` on activate.

McpGatewayStatusResponse.description: Daemon-proxied MCP gateway liveness + server runtime snapshot.
McpGatewayStatusResponse.title: McpGatewayStatusResponse

MediaRef.description: Reference to a user file stored locally under medousa/media/ (not inline bytes).

context_manifest_id.description: Optional durable context selection resolved by an earlier derivation.

source_session.description: Session in which the explicit stash was created. Navigation hint only; it does not grant access or imply a context selection.

PromptStashDraft.description: User-created composer state. Unlike automatic Home draft recovery, this is explicit, daemon-owned, and portable across clients of the same authority.

SessionDerivation.description: Audit record for materializing a context manifest as a new logical session. `intent` is descriptive metadata; all intents share this persistence path.

catalog.description: `shared` when indexed in the multi-member catalog; omitted for single-seat chats.

has_code_work.description: Sticky once a Forge code binding was set on the session.

SessionId.description: Canonical chat session identifier. Construction never normalizes input.

vaultChatFab.description: Vault note chat FAB on desktop. Default true when unset.

vaultSidebar.description: LME vault sidebar. Default visible when unset.

StreamUiScene.description: Liquid UI scene channel payload — a batch of model-authored scene ops for one turn. `ops` are forwarded verbatim as opaque JSON (the client decodes and validates them into typed `SceneOp`s); the daemon never inspects their shape.

ops.description: Ordered scene operations, opaque JSON validated client-side.

surface_id.description: Scene surface id; the client defaults to `chat:{turn_id}` when absent.

turn_id.description: Owning turn id (stamped by the stream event builder).

ToolInputParam.description: One redacted key/value from a tool's arguments, for chat-adjacent tool evidence. Values are truncated at the emit site; `truncated` tells the UI to say so.

TranscriptEntry.description: One immutable transcript payload at an ordered position in a session. Session authority and session id are carried by the enclosing history response; callers can combine them with these coordinates into a `TranscriptEntryRef`.

speaker_profile_id.description: Shared-room human speaker (`user:alice`). Absent on assistant turns / personal chats.

oneOf.description: Successful inference route for this assistant turn. This records the daemon-observed route after fallback, not the composer's requested pick.
Ephemeral-style progress captured between tool rounds (not the final answer).
Forward-compatible catch-all for newer clients reading older persisted timelines.
Trusted UI prompt for credential material. This event carries request metadata only; the value travels over the dedicated fulfill endpoint.

channel_surface.description: Adapter surface: telegram, discord, slack, home-desktop, home-ios, tui, api, …

supports_browser_host.description: When true, the connected client can run Agent Browser (local BrowserHost or client WebView). Telegram/TUI/ingest leave this false; Home desktop/iOS set true when browser is available.

supports_liquid_markdown.description: When true, the connected client can parse and hydrate Medousa Liquid Markdown embeds. This does not imply support for HTML artifacts, scenes, canvas, or UI authoring tools.

supports_ui_artifacts.description: When true, the connected client can render sandboxed HTML UI artifacts (`cognition_ui_present`). Channel adapters and clients set this — the daemon does not infer it from channel name.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent when complete or v1 adapter.

reset_required.description: Client must drop its cache and restart listing from the head.

truncated.description: When true, this page is a bounded adapter and must not be treated as complete.

vault_generation.description: Opaque vault generation for this page (H07.4).

indexing.description: True when the search index is rebuilding / not yet warm.

auto_workshop_tags.description: Merge default workshop + vault tags on write (default true).

session_id.description: Chat session id for workshop linking tags (`chat:…`, `session`, `profile:…`).

content.description: Body actually persisted (after semantic-tag rewrite). Clients use this to stay aligned with disk instead of assuming the request body was stored.

WorkerProgressDto.description: Streaming slice of a worker's live transcript — the `live_*` fields of `WorkCardDetail`, pushed instead of polled.

WorkerToolActivityDto.description: One worker tool run, shaped to match the host's `ToolRun` turn part so both render through the same chat evidence component.

context_line.description: Secondary context: intent, tools, wrapping-up reasons.

detail_line.description: Operator-facing task label (full prompt when user_ack is a slug).

intent.description: Worker intent or job family at emit time.

tool_names.description: Tools invoked on the work card when the event was emitted.

worker_progress.description: Live subagent progress rides along with `card_upserted` for turn-worker cards so chat can tick without a detail round trip.
